_doc: Ground truth traveler memory. kind: preference | fact | open_issue. match: all groups must hit, any word within a group (case insensitive substring) counts. say: what the traveler says in seeded sessions. ack: what the desk answers.

cust_marios.say: Could you put me in an aisle seat? I always prefer the aisle.
Please add a gluten free meal, I'm coeliac.
cust_marios.ack: I've requested a gluten free meal for you.

cust_marios.say: I prefer early morning departures so I can make afternoon meetings.
cust_marios.ack: Understood, I'll look at morning departures first.

cust_marios.statement: Flies to London for work with a client in Canary Wharf
cust_marios.say: These London trips are for work, my client is in Canary Wharf.
cust_marios.ack: Thanks, Heathrow has a good connection to Canary Wharf.

cust_marios.statement: Lost bag claim from a New York trip is still open
cust_marios.say: My bag went missing on the New York flight and the claim is still open.
cust_marios.ack: I've added a note to follow up on your lost bag claim from the New York trip.

cust_eleni.say: A window seat please, I like to look outside.
I'm vegetarian, can you add a vegetarian meal?
I'd rather fly out of Thessaloniki when possible, it's close to home.

cust_eleni.statement: Travels with a cello and books it an extra seat
cust_eleni.say: I'm travelling with my cello, it needs its own seat next to me.
cust_eleni.ack: I'll make sure the cello gets an extra seat beside you.

cust_eleni.statement: Refund for a cancelled Rome flight not received yet
cust_eleni.say: I still haven't received the refund for the cancelled Rome flight.
cust_eleni.ack: I've logged a follow up on your Rome refund.

cust_nikos.statement: Flies business class on long haul
cust_nikos.say: For long haul I always fly business class.
cust_nikos.ack: Business class for long haul, noted.

cust_nikos.statement: Wants an exit row for legroom
cust_nikos.say: On short flights get me an exit row, I need the legroom.
cust_nikos.ack: Exit row requested for the extra legroom.

cust_nikos.say: Please make sure I get a halal meal.
My wife usually comes with me, we sit together.
cust_nikos.ack: I'll keep you and your wife seated together.

cust_nikos.statement: Complaint about a broken seat on the Dubai flight is open
cust_nikos.say: I complained about a broken seat on my Dubai flight and nobody got back to me.
cust_nikos.ack: I've escalated your broken seat complaint from the Dubai flight.
